ThreadRealtimeStartTransport.description: EXPERIMENTAL - transport used by thread realtime.

sdp.description: SDP offer generated by a WebRTC RTCPeerConnection after configuring audio and the realtime events data channel.

description: EXPERIMENTAL - start a thread-scoped realtime session.

clientManagedHandoffs.description: Leaves Forall response handoffs to the client's explicit append calls instead of forwarding them automatically. Defaults to false.

forallResponseHandoffPrefix.description: Optional prefix added to automatic V1 Forall commentary sent with `conversation.handoff.append` when `codexResponsesAsItems` is not true. Final answers are sent without the prefix.

forallResponseItemPrefix.description: Optional prefix added to automatic Forall response items when `codexResponsesAsItems` is true.

forallResponsesAsItems.description: Sends automatic Forall responses as realtime conversation items instead of handoff appends.

includeStartupContext.description: Set to false to start without Forall's startup context. Omitted or null includes it.

model.description: Overrides the configured realtime model for this session only.

outputModality.description: Selects text or audio output for the realtime session. Transport and voice stay independent so clients can choose how they connect separately from what the model emits.

version.description: Overrides the configured realtime protocol version for this session only.

title: ThreadRealtimeStartParams
